'''March 2001 Bridgewater tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bridgewater, MA in March 2001. [[Michael Schiemer]] won it. It is known from Michael Schiemer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1962">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-bridgewater-mad1962/ bridgewater-ma], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 26 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-26-bridgewater-mad1962/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2001
* '''Site:''' Bridgewater, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Schiemer]]
